title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Universal Public Transport and Accessible Mobility Bill
objective: Track 1km transit stop radius coverage, disability accessibility compliance, and NMT lane safety.
affected_groups: Persons with disabilities and elderly commuters

indicators.name: Transit Stop 1km Urban Radius Coverage Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of urban residents within 1 km walking distance of a functional public transit stop.

oversight.composition: Disability rights advocates, urban transit planners, commuter representatives
oversight.powers: Statutory accessibility audit and grant disbursement

complaints.appeal_route: Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities / High Court

triggers.condition: Procurement or operation of non-accessible public buses or systemic transit stop radius gap.
triggers.correction: Grant withholding and fleet accessibility compliance directive
